incidents.name: ‘Project not specified’ errors reported for users in ap-northeast-2

incident_updates.body:
Between 04:56 UTC - 06:20 UTC projects in ap-northeast-2 encountered 4xx/5xx http errors retrieving project configuration from our upstream network partner with the error: Project not specified. 

The issue has since recovered and we are working with our network partner on a full review.

We will continue to monitor this issue until confirmed resolved.
We are investigating reports of users receiving ‘Project not specified’ errors in ap-northeast-2.

incidents.name: Projects in sa-east-1 experiencing delayed event ingestion

incident_updates.body:
The issue has been recovered for projects impacted in sa-east-1. Actual project health or uptime has not been impacted at any time.

Users still experiencing an unhealthy event notification on their dashboard can re-start their project to recover.

A full fix will be deployed end of today UTC.

EC2 scheduled events are timing out for projects in sa-east-1, leading to a subset of projects being reported as unhealthy in the Dashboard.

As a workaround, impacted users can re-start their project while we are working on providing a fix.

We will perform scheduled maintenance on the Shared Pooler (Supavisor) in the eu-central-2 region on Monday, November 30, from 13:00 to 15:00 UTC.

During the window, existing client connections may be dropped, and you may briefly see connection errors while traffic switches to the new version. Applications that reconnect and retry automatically will recover without action.

Direct database connections and the Dedicated Pooler are not affected.
